item.title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
item.description: Thirteen of the 18 startups in Peak XV’s latest Surge cohort are targeting global markets, while more than half are based in India.

item.title: 20+ excellent coffee machine deals to shop on Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days sale
item.description: Amazon Prime Big Deal Days has landed, and with International Coffee Day falling this week, I thought it best to seek out the best deals on a variety of home espresso machines.

item.title: How to get started with Shortcuts on your MacBook
item.description: Your Mac's Shortcuts app is a powerful way to automate tedious tasks, and you can now set up scripts using natural language.

item.title: Microsoft will give DARPA on-site access to its latest quantum computing hardware as it opens a new Maryland research center
item.description: Microsoft's new Maryland quantum center gives DARPA direct access to Majorana 2 for independent testing of its controversial topological computing approach.

item.title: OpenAI renonce à lancer une nouvelle IA, jugée insuffisamment alignée
item.description: OpenAI a renoncé au lancement d’un nouveau modèle d’intelligence artificielle (IA) de pointe, estimant que cette IA sortait trop souvent de son cadre et cherchait à tromper ses évaluateurs, a indiqué lundi l’entreprise à l’AFP.

item.description: We named the Ninja DoubleStack XXXL the best overall air fryer in Australia for its clever design and uncompromised performance, and it can be yours for a whopping 64% off.

item.title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
item.description: A top executive at the AI lab told the Wall Street Journal that the model in question had displayed a poor aptitude for following orders.
